executionResult.executionNotes: Added PDF metadata read/edit support and AES-256 password-protected PDF export with distinct user and owner passwords, eight-character minimums, confirmation checks, and view/print/forms/unrestricted permission presets. Existing PDFs can be opened with password retry prompts; encrypted documents are treated as read-only and excluded from editing saves/autosave. Retained the existing pdf-lib dependency for established page/edit workflows and isolated @cantoo/pdf-lib to the new security service.

tasks.name: Encrypted PDF Unlock and Secure Temp Storage
tasks.modelRationale: Unassigned. Select an approved available model for actual execution; no historical model is known.
deliverables: Prompt for password to unlock authorized encrypted PDFs
Never persist passwords or decrypted content outside secure temp storage
Temporary files cleaned on close and after crash recovery
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt for password to unlock authorized encrypted PDFs
Never persist passwords or decrypted content outside secure temp storage
Temporary files cleaned on close and after crash recovery

executionResult.executionNotes: Authorized encrypted PDFs prompt through PDF.js and stay read-only. Passwords are held only for the in-memory unlock callback; recent history stores only document metadata/path and autosave never stores protected bytes. Decrypted content remains in the PDF.js in-memory proxy; the app creates no decrypted temp files, so no plaintext is left for crash cleanup. Added explicit Close PDF and component teardown proxy destruction. Protected render/thumbnail paths reuse the authorized proxy instead of reopening encrypted bytes.

commands: With PATH prefixed by C:\Program Files\nodejs and CHROME_BIN set to Microsoft Edge: npx ng test --watch=false
verification.summary: All 106 application tests passed. Coverage includes password unlock/cancellation, read-only enforcement, no protected autosave/recent plaintext, authorized-proxy rendering, proxy cleanup on close/replacement, and full existing PDF workflows. No decrypted temp-file mechanism exists in the product.
